design: Each of18 attention and18 MLP final-token output sites, each locked quartet: subtract a*n times its native factorial interaction coefficient. Recompute current/downstream computation naturally, preserving native attention bus. Identity and paired +/- isotropic random factorial edits matched to removed interaction norm. Random direction fixed per quartet/site and shared across its four states, preserving additive factor coefficients.
selection: All sites evaluated; rank mean valence-aligned margin loss on familiar format A only. Other five cohorts remain native-failed diagnostics, not independent successful validation. No fitted featurizer or prediction from unseen labels.
limits: Four-state teacher-informed removal and all-site screening are exploratory. Removing output interaction is not a natural semantic intervention. Positive loss can reflect disruption; random controls constrain but do not eliminate that interpretation. No per-example competence filtering.
metrics: Native-minus-edited answer margin times intended binary valence; native-reference full-vocabulary KL; binary endpoint accuracy. Recompute quartet margin interaction coefficient to verify factorial accounting.
